subject: Vendor onboarding: Aurora Sensors — supplier record cleanup & bank details
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Asha Reddy <asha.reddy@aurora-sensors.com>; procurement@aurora-sensors.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff + supplier master cleanup checklist

Hi Asha / Aurora team —

Welcome — excited to get Aurora Sensors set up in our vendor master. We started intake for PO PO-2026-1198 and noticed a few items that need attention before we can finalize payment terms and activate the new payment route. Quick summary and asks: 

1) Supplier master records: our ERP shows two supplier records that look like duplicates (SupplierID 20987 and 3012). Can you confirm whether these represent the same legal entity or separate subsidiaries? If same, please confirm the registered business name and tax ID you want us to keep.

2) Address: the address we have on file for SupplierID 3012 is outdated (shows an old San Jose location). Please confirm your current remit and legal addresses.

3) Banking: we need a completed bank details form (attached stub) and a copy of a voided check or bank letter for ACH setup. If the payments should go to a new account, please indicate whether old invoices should be redirected.

4) Required docs: W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), vendor onboarding form, and the signed SOW/PO acceptance.

Attachments: I attached the bank details form and the vendor change template for your convenience.

Next steps: if you can reply with the confirmed address, tax ID (EIN), and the completed bank form by end of day Wednesday (2026-05-19), Dev will proceed with the supplier merge / update and Marcus will reconcile outstanding invoices.

Thanks — let me know if you'd prefer a quick 15-min call to walk through.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Thanks for the note and welcome. Quick answers below and I uploaded our docs to the procurement mailbox.

- Duplicate records: both SupplierID 20987 and 3012 refer to the same legal entity (Aurora Sensors, Inc.). The older record (3012) was used for a legacy division. Please keep the record tied to SupplierID 20987 and retire 3012.

- Registered name / Tax ID: Aurora Sensors, Inc. / EIN: 27-4912334 (please only use this EIN).

- Current address (legal & remit):
Aurora Sensors, Inc.
1202 Harbor Way
Suite 410
Oakland, CA 94607
United States

- Banking: attaching completed bank_details_form.xlsx and a bank letter PDF (attached as stub). Going forward please route payments to: Bank of Pacific — Acct ****4321 (Aurora Sensors, Inc.). Old account should be closed — no funds should be directed there for any invoice dated after 2026-04-30.

- W-9 attached (W-9_AuroraSensors.pdf).

Let me know if you need DUNS or additional vendor codes. Happy to hop on a short call if you prefer.

Thanks Asha — this is helpful. A couple of operational notes from our side: 

- ERP supplier merge: I ran a quick lookup. SupplierID 3012 has three historical invoices: INV-20251112-1001, INV-20251205-1016, and INV-20260103-1029. To merge 3012 into 20987 we need confirmation that those invoices should be migrated to SupplierID 20987 for AP reconciliation. Please confirm the invoice numbers or state if they should be paid to the legacy account.

- Tax docs: W-9 received. I will upload to the vendor file.

- Bank validation: our AP team requires either a voided check or bank letter (we have the bank letter stub you provided). I'll kick off the micro-deposit verification once we import the new account details. The field team uses director-approved templates; I'll attach the vendor_change_request.docx to the ERP ticket.

- Next: I'll open ERP ticket VCHG-20260517-39 for the merge and tagging of the new bank account. ETA for merge after docs/verification: 2 business days. Marcus — can you confirm that once merged AP will re-route payments and that the outstanding amounts tied to the old supplier will be applied to the parent record?

Thanks — copying the vendor admin contact to ensure portal uploads are received.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Senior Procurement Ops | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

If everything looks good we'll schedule the micro-deposit verification tomorrow and aim to include Aurora in the Friday payment cycle (2026-05-21) provided no holds.
